title: Resolving discarded workflow threads emits repo-owned thread records
wanted_capability: A way to discard stale workflow-origin wf-* threads without producing repo-owned .bbox/record artifacts or other reviewable exhaust for transient workflow scaffolding.
missing_primitive: discard/purge lifecycle for workflow-origin thread scaffolding that stays out of repo-owned record output
fallback_used: Manually removed the untracked .bbox/record/thread-*.json files produced while resolving stale wf-* workflow threads.
notes: During cleanup of stale wf-* workflow threads, bbox_thread(action=resolve) wrote 28 untracked .bbox/record/thread-*.json files for transcript-search workflow scaffolding. The operator characterized these as discardable workflow exhaust and likely defect; tmux workflow test arcs resolved without the same repo record output.
resolution_note: Fixed 2026-07-14 on beta/blackbox-v2: thread_resolve skips the repo-owned .bbox/record/ snapshot when thread.origin == Workflow — transient wf-* arc scaffolding can now be discarded without leaving reviewable exhaust (its audit trail is the arc event log + arc thread notes, which stay host-local). thread_promote deliberately still writes a record: promotion is the operator elevating a workflow thread to durable, which per the repo-owned-project-state convention belongs in committed .bbox/. Regression test resolve_skips_record_for_workflow_origin_threads.
